catalog.name: 月末付费会员购买人数

sources.quote: 自然月内有至少一笔有效订单、且月末符合总部运营月报付费资格的不同账户数。
本次付费会员的月度指标按自然月月底最后一天的资格判断。先选月末有资格的账户，再统计这些账户当月全渠道、全门店的有效订单；不要求每笔订单发生当天也已经具有资格。有效购买沿用本次财务邮件的订单规则。
只纳入悦享年卡与家庭季卡持有人。异业联名卡即使收费也由合作方经营，不属本期自营会员范围；体验卡不纳入。
权益在生效日期当天起有效；计划权益结束日期当天已无效；存在提前终止日期时，从提前终止当天起无效。
多张有效卡不重复计账户，也不重复累计订单（MSG-03848；MSG-03886、03888、03890）。
一行一份 CRM 会员账户；账户不等于跨系统自然人，也不等于自然人数。

constraints: 聚合事实对象为月末有资格的 CRM 会员账户-自然月粒度；资格按自然月最后一天判断，卡产品仅悦享年卡、家庭季卡，且同一张卡满足 valid_from <= 月末日 < valid_until 与 (ended_at 为空或月末日 < ended_at)；同一账户任一卡满足即计一次，多卡不重复计账户。
纳入行集合为上述账户在该自然月内至少一笔有效订单；有效订单为 status='paid' 且 paid_cents - refund_cents > 0，按原订单下单日期归属自然月。
仅支持完整自然月、全门店、全渠道；多月按月分别列出，不按门店或渠道拆分；无购买账户时计数为 0。
按 CRM 会员账户计数，不做跨系统自然人去重；多卡不重复计账户。

model_sql.monthly_paid_member: WITH RECURSIVE month_spine AS (SELECT DATE '2024-09-01' AS month_start, DATE '2024-09-30' AS month_end UNION ALL SELECT CAST(month_start + INTERVAL '1 month' AS DATE) AS month_start, CAST(month_start + INTERVAL '2 month' - INTERVAL '1 day' AS DATE) AS month_end FROM month_spine WHERE month_start < DATE '2026-08-01'), eligible_cards AS (SELECT c.member_id, m.month_start, m.month_end FROM {{ ref('cards') }} c JOIN month_spine m ON c.card_type IN ('悦享年卡', '家庭季卡') AND c.valid_from <= m.month_end AND m.month_end < c.valid_until AND (c.ended_at IS NULL OR m.month_end < c.ended_at)), eligible_members AS (SELECT member_id, month_start, MAX(month_end) AS month_end FROM eligible_cards GROUP BY member_id, month_start), monthly_orders AS (SELECT member_id, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, SUM(paid_cents - refund_cents) AS net_sales_cents FROM {{ ref('orders') }} WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 GROUP BY member_id, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) AS DATE)) SELECT e.member_id || '|' || CAST(e.month_start AS VARCHAR) AS member_month_key, e.member_id, e.month_start, e.month_end, COALESCE(o.valid_order_count, 0) AS valid_order_count, COALESCE(o.net_sales_cents, 0) AS net_sales_cents FROM eligible_members e LEFT JOIN monthly_orders o ON e.member_id = o.member_id AND e.month_start = o.month_start
